reason: The client journey now connects a clear no-fee, semester-long offer to services, team size, client responsibilities, confidentiality discussion and a useful inquiry. Desktop and mobile homepage captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy, restrained color and well-separated audience actions. I traced Home → Work → practical questions → Contact in actual source and checked the corresponding intercepted browser journey. The former mobile continuity defect is resolved: a native organization selector puts the selected profile immediately below it, with first/middle/last selection checks in the supplied logs. Inquiry recovery also materially improves: pending fields lock, malformed receipts preserve answers, deadlines restore controls, field errors receive focus and unchanged retries reuse a delivery key. Nevertheless, a prospective client still cannot inspect an actual MECG decision, method or handoff. That directly prevents the evidence-assessment part of my assigned task, so I disagree with the broad world-class claim. Local verification supports implementation quality within its recorded scope; it does not establish actual delivery or the private recruitment/operator service end to end. Overall release readiness remains unproven.

findings.evidence: The approved fallback remains empty. Organization profiles expressly withhold project scope, methods, deliverables and outcomes pending approval; Selected work renders only when publicProjects has records. The supplied homepage captures show the corresponding pending-client-approval status, and UNRESOLVED.md confirms actual approved engagement evidence is absent. Changing the empty-state heading to Past partnerships fixes the promise mismatch but does not supply delivery evidence.
findings.userImpact: A client can establish fit and organizational associations but cannot assess the rigor or relevance of a real MECG recommendation before investing time and access in an inquiry.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain client and Board approval for one bounded engagement with its question, MECG contribution, methods, constraints and redacted handoff excerpt. Publish through the existing approval boundary; preserve the honest pending state until permission exists.

notVerified: Actual Resend acceptance/delivery, production configuration and Board response time; intercepted contact receipts are synthetic.
Hosted Clerk/Supabase/RLS/storage integration, authenticated application/status and consequential grading/operator recovery; these were not independently exercised in this seat.
Observed human comprehension/task success, assistive-technology use, physical iPhone or macOS Safari behavior, and full sequential keyboard traversal across Home, Work and Contact.
Approved real engagement artifacts, current membership workload facts and Board decisions on original-resume access, retention and closed-round remediation.
